name: Toga ~Kegareta Shizuku~
source:
Main character's past of abuse by his father keeps pursuing him. One day a girl who claims to be his sister shows up, and they have a confrontation. Then his former tutor who is also his first sexual partner, shows up. Protagonist's heart gets violently disturbed - what will he do?

[From [url=https://forums.fuwanovel.net/blogs/entry/2705-vn-of-the-month-april-2002-duo-~song-for-all~.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公被父亲虐待的过去一直纠缠着他。一天，一个自称是他妹妹的女孩出现了，他们发生了对峙。接着，他的前任家教——同时也是他的第一个性伴侣——也出现了。主人公的内心被剧烈地搅动了——他会怎么做？

[来自[url=https://forums.fuwanovel.net/blogs/entry/2705-vn-of-the-month-april-2002-duo-~song-for-all~.html]vndbreview[/url]]
